name: PD 154 was established by Ordinance No. 17922, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 20, 1983. Ordinance No. 17922 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 17922 was amended by Ordinance No. 18314, passed by the Dallas City  Council on June 27, 1984. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17922; 18314; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 154 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 154 was established by Ordinance No. 17922, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 20, 1983. Ordinance No. 17922 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 17922 was amended by Ordinance No. 18314, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 27, 1984. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17922; 18314; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 154 is established on property generally located at the north corner of Rawlins Street and Welborn Street. The size of PD 154 is approximately 1.0032 acres. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-154.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. All property in this PD must be developed in accordance with the development plan approved by the city plan commission on June 7, 1984, which is labelled Exhibit 154A. (Ord. Nos. 18314; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.105.USES. Uses within this PD are limited to 6,500 square feet of retail uses and 168,300 square feet of office and residential uses, as those uses are defined in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.106.SETBACKS. Setbacks must be maintained in accordance with the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.107.FLOOR AREA. Maximum floor area for all buildings in this PD is 174,800 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.108.HEIGHT. Maximum height for all buildings and structures in this PD is 212 feet. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.109.PARKING. The number of required off-street parking spaces for this PD is 507. All off-street parking spaces must be below grade or enclosed within a structure. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.110.LANDSCAPING. Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan. All landscaping must be properly maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.111.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Utilization of the Property must conform to all applicable codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.112.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.113.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there is full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-154.114.ZONING MAP. PD 154 is located on Zoning Map No. I-7. (Ord. Nos. 17922; 25508)
